transcriber_notes: niViz chart (1413x1432 PNG with a transparent background, composited onto white). Snow height axis 0 at y 1377 and 80 cm at y 238 (14.24 px/cm); boundaries 48, 46, 31, 29, 18, 17 (+-0.2 cm; table rows and bar steps agree; the thin 18-17 cm row is drawn taller with a dotted leader). Hardness from the R column (1, 1, 2, 4.5, 2.33, 5, 2.33; 4.5 read as P+ and uncertain), matching the hatched bar ends on the hand-hardness axis (F 442, 4F 409, 1F 347, P 244, K 38 px). The form, size and θ columns are blank below 29 cm, so those layers have no grain form. No temperature profile and no density column. Arrows: CT1 SC at 47 cm, CT13 RP at 29 cm. Lemons columns recorded in the layer comments. The right-hand 'Structure index' panel (bars coloured by grain type, red arrows at about 47 and 38.5 cm) is not recorded.
